title: DiagramAgent CompositionSpec
description: Portable semantic JSON for composed architecture diagrams. Describe structure and intent; DiagramAgent handles layout, routing, numbering, wrapping and rendering.

version.description: Optional grammar version marker. Omit or set to 1.

title.description: Page title: concise system or product name.

subtitle.description: One-sentence purpose and scope for the diagram.

badge.description: Optional header badge with platform/runtime facts.

columns.description: Left-to-right story columns. Use 2-4 when possible.

connectors.description: Few deliberate connectors. Step arrows inside flows are automatic.

Tone.description: Semantic colour tone: blue request/core compute, purple async/integration, green identity/governance/success, orange controls/warnings/human action, red threats/failure, teal data/analytics, gray neutral/tooling/boundary.

Card.description: A service, actor, system, datastore or shared dependency card.

id.description: Optional stable kebab-case id. Keep it stable across edits; omitted ids are derived from titles.

title.description: Card title: a concise service, actor, system or datastore name.

items.description: Short body line; prefer concrete facts.

lines.description: Short body lines describing what this card is or holds.

note.description: Muted footnote for posture, constraints, ownership or retention.

tone.description: Semantic colour tone for the card.

icon.description: Icon key from the vendored icon registry.

items.description: Flow id, label or title that uses this card.

usedBy.description: Flow references shown as used-by chips instead of dependency lines.

Grid.description: A compact 2- or 3-column grid of cards.

id.description: Optional stable kebab-case id. Keep it stable across edits; omitted ids are derived from titles.

columns.description: Number of card columns in this grid; use 2 unless the cards are very small.

Banner.description: A full-width strip for hosting, runtime, network or boundary context.

id.description: Optional stable kebab-case id. Keep it stable across edits; omitted ids are derived from titles.

title.description: Banner title naming the context or boundary.

text.description: Short detail line shown under the banner title.

tone.description: Semantic colour tone for the banner.

Flow.description: An end-to-end flow lane with a letter badge, trigger subtitle, ordered steps and invariant notes.

type.description: Discriminator for a flow lane item.

id.description: Optional stable kebab-case id. Keep it stable across edits; omitted ids are derived from titles.

label.description: Optional lane label such as A or B; assigned automatically when omitted.

title.description: Flow title naming the path or job.

subtitle.description: Trigger such as route, function, topic, event or schedule.

tag.description: Small status pill; use only for special status such as ASYNC or Human in the loop.

tone.description: Semantic colour tone for the lane.

steps.description: Ordered flow steps; use 3-5 verb-led steps when possible.

items.description: One-line invariant or guarantee for the flow.

notes.description: Invariant notes shown below the steps.

chips.description: Small chips under the lane for tracked outputs or key facts.

items.description: Chip texts shown under the lane.

Step.description: One verb-led action inside a flow lane.

id.description: Optional stable kebab-case id. Keep it stable across edits; omitted ids are derived from titles.

title.description: Verb-led step title, for example Authenticate or Index.

tone.description: Semantic colour tone for the step; defaults to the flow tone.

icon.description: Icon key from the vendored icon registry.

id.description: Optional stable kebab-case id. Keep it stable across edits; omitted ids are derived from titles.

title.description: Column heading; do not include numbering because the engine adds it.

size.description: Width hint: narrow for callers, wide for the main workload, normal for shared services.

items.description: Items stacked in reading order within the column.

Connector.description: A deliberate connector between cards, flows or steps. Use few connectors; prefer usedBy chips for shared services.

from.description: Source reference: id, full model id, flow.step, flow label, or unique title.

to.description: Target reference: id, full model id, flow.step, flow label, or unique title.

kind.description: flow for caller-to-lane arrows; call for dependency calls from a step to another system.

label.description: Short connector label, especially for call connectors.

tone.description: Optional semantic colour tone for the connector.

Footer.description: Outcome and status band at the bottom of the page.

text.description: One sentence describing the business or operational outcome.

status.description: Short state label such as CURRENT STATE, TARGET STATE or PILOT.

Badge.description: Compact platform/runtime badge in the header.

title.description: Badge title, often the platform or runtime.

Item.description: A column item. Pick one object with a type discriminator.
